# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 3 tokens; Text — 2 tokens; Fills and status backgrounds — 3 tokens; Borders and rings — 1 token; Palette ramps and brand — 6 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 9 tokens; Radius — 4 tokens; Stroke — 3 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--surface, #f3f6f4);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--surface, #0c1716);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #f3f6f4;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--surface` | #f3f6f4 | #0c1716 | Fond de page. Porte `ink`, `ink-soft`, `brand` (liens) et `loss` à 4,5:1 minimum dans les deux thèmes. Le dashboard en direct utilise toujours le thème sombre. |
| `--surface-raised` | #ffffff | #142423 | Cartes, champs de saisie, feuilles et barre d'onglets. Porte `ink`, `ink-soft`, `brand`, `loss` et `signal` (thème sombre seulement) à 4,5:1 minimum. |
| `--surface-strong` | #e4ebe8 | #1c3231 | Zones en creux, survol, choix sélectionné, éléments verrouillés, piste des jauges. Porte `ink`, `ink-soft`, `brand` et `loss` à 4,5:1 minimum. |

## Color · Text

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--ink, #11201f);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--ink, #eef5f2);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #11201f;
```

### Tokens (2)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--ink` | #11201f | #eef5f2 | Texte courant sur `surface`, `surface-raised` et `surface-strong`. Trait du logo sur fond clair ou sombre. |
| `--ink-soft` | #3f5350 | #a9bdb8 | Texte secondaire (aides, métadonnées, onglets inactifs) sur `surface`, `surface-raised` et `surface-strong`. Jamais en dessous de 14px. |

## Color · Fills and status backgrounds

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--on-brand, #ffffff);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--on-brand, #0c1716);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #ffffff;
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--on-brand` | #ffffff | #0c1716 | Texte et icônes posés sur `brand` et `brand-hover`. Blanc en thème clair, sombre en thème sombre : jamais de blanc littéral. |
| `--on-signal` | #11201f | #0c1716 | Texte et icônes posés sur `signal` (10,9:1 en clair, 11,8:1 en sombre). |
| `--on-loss` | #ffffff | #0c1716 | Texte posé sur un fond `loss`. |

## Color · Borders and rings

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--border-ui, #6b817d);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--border-ui, #7c9893);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #6b817d;
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--border-ui` | #6b817d | #7c9893 | Contour des champs, boutons secondaires, choix non sélectionnés et traits d'arbre. 3:1 minimum sur `surface`, `surface-raised` et `surface-strong`. |

## Color · Palette ramps and brand

### Use

```css
/* in a page’s CSS, in the light theme: the token’s name, with its value from the same row of the table below as the fallback, so the page draws whether or not it links tokens.css */
color: var(--line, #c9d6d2);
/* a page in another theme: link or inline tokens.css, put data-theme="dark" on the element that wraps the page, and take each fallback from the dark column; where tokens.css cannot be linked, the value alone, from that theme’s column */
color: var(--line, #2e4745);
/* on a slide, in a chart’s options, or anywhere else var() cannot go, and in an SVG attribute such as fill, which not every browser reads var() in: the value alone, from the column of the theme it is in */
color: #c9d6d2;
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | light | dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--line` | #c9d6d2 | #2e4745 | Séparateurs et contour de carte, purement décoratifs. Ne délimite jamais seul un champ, un bouton ou un choix : utiliser `border-ui`. |
| `--brand` | #0c5c57 | #5ed3c6 | Couleur de marque : fond des actions principales (texte `on-brand`), liens, état Juste, choix sélectionné, onglet actif. Elle s'éclaircit en thème sombre. |
| `--brand-hover` | #094744 | #8fe3d9 | Survol et appui des actions principales. Texte `on-brand` dessus. |
| `--signal` | #ffc83d | #ffc83d | Jaune d'attention réservé au direct et à la pastille du pronostic. Toujours un fond avec `on-signal` dessus. Seul sur fond clair il n'atteint que 1,5:1 : ne jamais l'utiliser en texte ni en trait clair. |
| `--loss` | #b3263e | #ff8da0 | Erreurs de saisie, état Faux, actions destructives. Toujours accompagné d'une icône et d'un mot, jamais seul. En thème sombre il s'éclaircit. |
| `--focus` | #11201f | #ffc83d | Anneau de focus : trait plein de 3px décalé de 2px (`stroke-focus`). 3:1 minimum sur toutes les surfaces, dans les deux thèmes. |

## Type

Set text in one of the styles below: write its values from the Styles and Families tables, or, on a page that links or inlines tokens.css, prefer its variable, where the Styles table’s CSS column gives one.

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a style’s values from the Styles and Families tables */
font: 800 56px/60px "Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the variables, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
font: var(--text-display-xl); letter-spacing: -0.01em;
font-family: var(--font-display);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line, italic, letter spacing | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `display-xl` | `.display-xl`, `--text-display-xl` | 56px / 60px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 800 | `display` | Titre d'une page d'accueil de tournoi. Archivo en largeur 125 (`font-stretch: 125%`). |
| `display` | `.display`, `--text-display` | 40px / 44px, letter-spacing -0.01em | 800 | `display` | Titre de page. |
| `title` | `.title`, `--text-title` | 28px / 34px | 700 | `display` | Titre de section ou d'écran mobile. |
| `heading` | `.heading`, `--text-heading` | 22px / 28px | 700 | `display` | Titre de carte. |
| `score` | `.score`, `--text-score` | 40px / 40px | 800 | `display` | Scores et points. Chiffres tabulaires. |
| `body-lg` | `.body-lg`, `--text-body-lg` | 18px / 28px | 400 | `body` | Texte d'introduction. |
| `body` | `.body`, `--text-body` | 16px / 24px | 400 | `body` | Texte courant, valeur des champs, boutons (en 700). |
| `body-sm` | `.body-sm`, `--text-body-sm` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `body` | Aides, métadonnées. Taille minimale du produit. |
| `label` | `.label`, `--text-label` | 14px / 20px | 700 | `body` | Libellés de champ, badges, onglets. |
| `overline` | `.overline`, `--text-overline` | 14px / 20px, letter-spacing 0.06em | 700 | `body` | Sigle de statut en capitales (EN DIRECT). Seul usage des capitales. |
| `dash-body` | `.dash-body`, `--text-dash-body` | 32px / 44px | 400 | `body` | Texte courant du dashboard projeté, lisible à 10 m. |
| `dash-title` | `.dash-title`, `--text-dash-title` | 56px / 60px | 800 | `display` | Titre du tournoi et noms d'équipes. |
| `dash-score` | `.dash-score`, `--text-dash-score` | 112px / 112px | 800 | `display` | Score du match en cours. Chiffres tabulaires. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `display` | `--font-display` | `"Archivo", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif` |
| `body` | `--font-body` | `"Atkinson Hyperlegible", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif` |

## Spacing

### Use

```css
/* any surface: a token’s value from the table below */
padding: 4px;
/* a page that links or inlines tokens.css: prefer the token’s name, so that a change to tokens.css reaches the page */
padding: var(--space-1);
```

### Tokens (9)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-1` | 4px | Entre un libellé et son aide, entre une icône et son mot. |
| `--space-2` | 8px | Entre éléments liés (icône et texte, badges). |
| `--space-3` | 12px | Marge intérieure d'un champ ou d'un choix. |
| `--space-4` | 16px | Marge intérieure d'une carte, gouttière mobile. |
| `--space-6` | 24px | Entre cartes, entre groupes de champs. |
| `--space-8` | 32px | Entre sections. |
| `--space-12` | 48px | Marge d'une page web ou d'un écran projeté. |
| `--target-web` | 44px | Hauteur minimale d'un bouton, d'un champ ou d'un lien isolé sur le web. |
| `--target-mobile` | 48px | Zone tactile minimale sur mobile (48 dp Android, au-delà des 44 pt iOS). |
